score_meaning: Editorial fit judgment, not measured traffic, model benchmarks or security certification

candidates.adopt: Question-specific information gain, predeclared hypothesis, one metric, guardrails and inconclusive outcomes.
candidates.exclude: Example uplift, generic sample targets, CTA funnel, runtime installation and claimed randomized WeChat testing.
candidates.reason: Strong experiment planning; website-testing assumptions need observational adaptation.

candidates.adopt: Explicit information role, layout/style/palette separation and saved full prompts; refine existing integration.
candidates.exclude: Changing five-image count, mandatory numeric labels, new publishing plugin or image backend wrapper.
candidates.reason: Direct illustration fit. Verified head is not a new model or news release.

candidates.adopt: Reader task and question before demographic personas; public evidence versus editorial hypotheses.
candidates.exclude: Private messages, support-ticket collection, profiling, mass distribution and invented reader quotes.
candidates.reason: Good problem discipline; broad social instructions need privacy and channel restrictions.

candidates.adopt: Relationship-oriented sequence, comparison, components and decision boundaries; sparse semantic icons.
candidates.exclude: Inferring missing facts, renderer installation and SVG replacement for generated PNG delivery.
candidates.reason: Strong structure vocabulary; production rendering deliberately outside integration.

candidates.adopt: Visual pacing, consistent identity and progressive disclosure across five roles.
candidates.exclude: Role-played experience, unsupported uplift targets, video creation and cross-platform deployment.
candidates.reason: Useful art-direction checklist but role metric targets are not evidence.

verification: Public GitHub metadata and commit-specific contents reads. Blob hashes identify inspected text; licenses reported by GitHub metadata. No upstream code executed.
